item.title: Alexandria Museum of Art announces 2026 Gifted and Talented winners
item.description: The Alexandria Museum of Art is celebrating the 2026 Gifted and Talented student art winners from across the Rapides Parish School District. item.title: City won’t pursue special events security measure, will seek police-fire cross-use authority
item.description: By JIM BUTLER The administration has dropped plans to seek new authorities relative to firearms possession at Alexandria parades and other special events. item.title: Three file in Pineville mayoral race
item.description: By JIM BUTLER Interim Mayor Joe Bishop drew two opponents in Wednesday qualifying for Pineville’s May 16 primary.
